instruction: A studio portrait photograph, captured in a medium close-up shot at eye level. In a minimalist indoor photo studio with a seamless white background, the red-haired woman in the blue shirt (R2) is on the left, leaning her upper body slightly toward her friend and looking directly at the camera with a soft, slightly parted-lip expression. Beside her on the right, the curly-haired woman in the green crop top (R1) stands holding a silver water bottle in her left hand near her chest, looking directly at the camera with a gentle, confident expression. The red-haired woman (R2) rests her left arm and hand over the right shoulder of the curly-haired woman (R1) as they stand close together. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting with soft shadows, creating a clean white and pastel color palette.
